crossRefs.note: “It is all the same. Therefore I say he destroys the blameless and the wicked.
If the scourge kills suddenly, he will mock at the trial of the innocent.
If I wash myself with snow, and cleanse my hands with lye,
yet you will plunge me in the ditch. My own clothes will abhor me.
They tell God, ‘Depart from us, for we don’t want to know about your ways.
that the evil man is reserved to the day of calamity, That they are led out to the day of wrath?
who said to God, ‘Depart from us;’ and, ‘What can the Almighty do for us?’
that you ask, ‘What advantage will it be to you? What profit will I have, more than if I had sinned?’
You have said, ‘It is vain to serve God;’ and ‘What profit is it that we have followed his instructions, and that we…
Will he delight himself in the Almighty, and call on God at all times?
Also delight yourself in Yahweh, and he will give you the desires of your heart.

translations.web: For he has said, ‘It profits a man nothing that he should delight himself with God.’
translations.bsb: For he has said, ‘It profits a man nothing that he should delight in God.’
translations.kjv: For he hath said, It profiteth a man nothing that he should delight himself with God.
translations.asv: For he hath said, It profiteth a man nothing That he should delight himself with God.
